top_signals.title: Bitcoin Briefly Dips Below $80,000 as Volatility Roils Markets
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin briefly slid below $80,000 for the first time in almost a month, swept up in a broader retreat from risk assets as an AI-led selloff on Wall Street undercut crypto’s attempt to rebuild a bullish tone.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: G7 Pledges €2.5 Billion for Fertilizers, Food as War Hits Supply
top_signals.summary: The Group of Seven nations allocated €2.5 billion ($2.8 billion) to provide fertilizers and bolster food security for poorer countries, especially in Africa, French Finance Minister Roland Lescure said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ugandan Shilling Rallies for Second Day After Jumbo Rate Hike
top_signals.summary: Uganda’s shilling extended gains for a second day Thursday after the central bank delivered its biggest interest-rate increase since 2011 and was suspected of selling dollars.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
